I don’t have live access to weather data or your location, so I can’t see today’s conditions directly.

To check the weather right now, use one of these:

- On your phone:  
  - iOS: Weather app or “Hey Siri, what’s the weather today?”  
  - Android: Google Weather or “Hey Google, what’s the weather today?”

- On the web:  
  - weather.com  
  - google.com: search “weather” or “weather [your city]”

If you tell me your city or region, I can describe the typical weather for this time of year and help you interpret the forecast once you look it up.
